title: #stitch @maeve⭐️🫶🏻 And here’s where I talk about seeing Wicked a bunc...
transcript: okay I have to confess that there was one time and one time only that I did this where I saw the same show twice in one day last year I made a video talking about how there was a chapter in my life when I was in middle school where I was a little bit of a Wicked super fan when it was playing an extended sit down run in my hometown of San Francisco there's some additional context to that which I talked about in detail in that video from last year so I'll link that in the caption but on the last day of the San Francisco run in 2010 there were two performances that day and I did in fact go to both of them at that point I had already seen the show so many times that seeing it twice in one day especially when there was like an added weight to it of it being the last day it didn't really faze me that much if anything it was the matinee that felt a little bit extraneous to me where I was a little bit like I don't know that I NEED to be watching this right now when I know that I'm gonna be watching it later tonight but I was still happy to be there especially as this last hurrah and it makes for a fun story that I get to tell now also fun fact at the matinee that day Elphaba was played by Alyssa Fox who has now gone on to be like one of the most long-running prolific Elphabas that was actually only her second performance ever playing the role and I also saw her first performance a few months earlier
